evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No framing present. Rep jumps from collecting zip codes straight into 'I can create a profile for you so we can give you an estimate'—no time-boxed ask, no promise of dependability, no wait for customer agreement
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep collects logistics (dates, addresses, room count, items) with no inquiry about concerns like reliability or damage protection
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns raised by customer during step 2, so N/A applies
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No concerns raised, so N/A applies
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: Rep mentions 'no worries damage coverage...up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages' and 'on time guarantee if we run late, we provide discounts'—both present but vague on terms. On-Time Guarantee stated as 'discounts' with no specifics on $50/$25 structure. Damage coverage stated as coverage amount but no mention of 'no deductible' or 'built into the rate, not an add-on.' No permission lead-in asked.

evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening: No concern-led opening. Rep asks 'Alright, and may I also have your email address' and 'How did you hear about us?' before pivoting to logistics—standard checklist approach, not concern-driven
evidence_quotes.logistics_covered: Addresses gathered (storage/mom's house, destination), property type (apartment), floor (second floor), room count (one bedroom), special items (washer/dryer, bed, couch). Missing: walking distance at both ends, additional rooms (garage, shed, study), overall property context. Partial coverage.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Rep asks 'How many boxes are we moving? Fifteen to 25.' Customer says 'less than that.' Rep never circles back with typical box count for this home size or follow-up on collections. Box count asked once, packing (would you like us to pack) never asked.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep says 'let me just explain to you how we work in our pricing. So we charge hourly rates for the services we offer...all of that is in the price. The only one outside of the hourly rate...is a one time transportation fee of $75.' This covers the pricing contrast (hourly all-inclusive vs. add-ons) and fee transparency. Missing: Cameron's no-notes line ('no need to take notes, I'll send all of it over') and not-a-guess commitment. Two of three present.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides typical range ('two and a half to three and a half hours to complete...three and a half to four and a half hour mark...estimated budget of $975') and personalizes to this move (one bedroom, second floor, travel to Round Rock ~40 min). Range and personalization both present.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Move is scheduled for 'the twenty first at the month' (31st per clarification). Rep never identifies which Value Day branch applies, never offers a cheaper day alternative, never asks about date flexibility.
evidence_quotes.prep_and_temperature_check: Rep states 'it just really depends on how long the move is gonna take since we charge by the time' but never uses Save Your Ass framing (preparation is biggest factor, small stuff slows crews). Never asks 'How do you feel about that?' with silence held.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep does not ask 'What's still concerning you about this move?' Call ends with rep saying 'I'll still send you an email so you can read through it' and customer saying 'Okay, thank you.' No genuine concerns check.
evidence_quotes.followup_on_remaining_concern: Customer raises price concern late ('That's a lot of money') and rep acknowledges briefly ('Mm-hmm now, of course. This may still change if it takes shorter...') but does not probe deeply. However, this is not a step 6 check, so N/A applies for formal step 6 scoring.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Never asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Neither rate lock nor no-deposit statement made. No plain ask like 'Would you like our help with your move?' Rep ends with 'I'll still send you an email so you can read through it' and does not ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Customer did not book on this call (customer said 'I'm gonna think about it cause there's a lot of money'). Booking_confirmed is N/A because the rep never asked for the business.

top_strength: Joanna gathered logistics methodically—addresses, floor level, item type, rough load size—and delivered a personalized hourly estimate range anchored to the customer's specific move profile.
coaching_note: Start every call with a genuine quid pro quo (time-boxed promise + dependable quote + wait for yes) and ask the two-concerns question before diving into the checklist, so you frame around what matters to the customer instead of data collection.
